label: Library Tweaks
Small tweaks for the native Zen Library. Each feature below toggles independently.
Features
Saves section (bookmarks)
Turning it off unregisters everything and restores native behavior immediately, no restart needed (the urlbar provider, once loaded, stays until restart).
Hide other root folders
Shows only the Saves root folder's contents; hides Menu, Other Bookmarks and Mobile Bookmarks at the root level. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
Media
Wider panel for the native Media section (1.9x)

Grows the Library panel to 794px while Zen's native Media tab is showing — 1.9x the 418px width of Downloads and the other sections — with a roomier grid (larger cards, wider gaps, like the old custom tab). Off keeps Media at the same width as the other sections. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
Rename and Delete in the media menu
Adds Rename file and Delete file to the right-click menu on Zen's native Media cards. Acts on the file on disk and refreshes the grid in place. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
Sidebar
Drag sidebar tabs to rearrange sections
Drag any Library sidebar tab up or down to rearrange the sections. The arrangement is remembered across restarts. Turning this off locks the tabs in place.
Shortcuts
Ctrl+D (Cmd+D on macOS) smart-saves the page
Saves the current page with generated title and tags instead of opening the native bookmark panel. Off hands the key back to Firefox.
Ctrl+H (Cmd+H on macOS) opens Library History
Takes over the history shortcut so it opens the native Library on History instead of the Firefox sidebar. Off hands the key back.
Ctrl+J (Cmd+J on macOS) opens Library Downloads
Takes over the downloads shortcut so it opens the native Library on Downloads. Off hands the key back.
History
Recently closed tabs in History

Shows Recently closed tabs and Clear recent history shortcuts above the native History list. Closed tabs open in a sliding pane with reopen and forget actions. Off restores the native History tab. Applies immediately, no restart needed.
Right-click menu on history items
Adds Copy, Forget About This Site and Delete to right-clicked history rows, like the classic library.
Boosts
Better Boosts presentation
Groups boosts under domain headers with large icon tiles and a strike-through on disabled boosts. Row behavior stays native.
Downloads
Show Downloads folder instead of history

Replaces the browser download history with the actual top-level files and folders in the Downloads folder (hidden/partial skipped), with Open, Show in Folder, Rename and Delete. Files downloaded in the browser keep their source link via Copy Download Link. Respects the native search term and type/date filters.
Rename files from the menu
Adds Rename file to the download context menus. File icons already resolve from the OS exactly like the classic library, so there is nothing to toggle there.
Grey out moved or missing files
Dims download rows whose files are gone from disk. Moved or missing files are also excluded from renaming, so no stray divider is left behind.
Animation
Animate section switches
Fades and rises incoming sections when switching tabs, using the classic easing. Respects reduced-motion settings.
